title: 2018 Big 12 Title Game: How OU Avenged Its Loss to Texas, 39-27
question: Who won the 2018 Big 12 Championship Game between Oklahoma and Texas?
answer: Oklahoma won the 2018 Big 12 Championship Game 39-27 over Texas on December 1, 2018, in Arlington, avenging a 48-45 regular-season loss. It was OU's fourth straight Big 12 title and 12th overall.
summary: OU beat Texas 39-27 in the 2018 Big 12 Championship, avenging a 48-45 loss in Dallas. Kyler Murray threw for 379 yards as OU won a fourth straight title.
body: The 2018 season gave Sooner fans something rare: two Red River games in one year. The first, in October at the Cotton Bowl, went to Texas 48-45. Oklahoma rallied from a 21-point hole to tie the game at 45 late, only for Texas freshman Cameron Dicker to hit a 40-yard field goal with 14 seconds left. It was OU's only regular-season loss.

Eight weeks later the teams met again in the Big 12 Championship Game in Arlington, the first time the rivals had ever played each other in a championship game. On December 1, 2018, the fifth-ranked Sooners beat No. 9 Texas 39-27.

Kyler Murray was sharp, completing 25 of 34 passes for 379 yards and three touchdowns. Two of those scores went to tight end Grant Calcaterra, including an 18-yard one-handed grab on third-and-10 with about two minutes left that sealed it.

The Sooner defense came up with the decisive plays. In the fourth quarter, Tre Brown blitzed and sacked Sam Ehlinger in the end zone for a safety, and in the final minute Tre Norwood intercepted Ehlinger's last pass.

The win gave Oklahoma its 12th Big 12 championship and its fourth straight outright title, and it kept the Sooners' College Football Playoff hopes alive. One quirk for trivia fans: the Golden Hat was not on the line in the title game, so it stayed with Texas after the October result.
